name: addonry
description: Manual-only tri-client plugin for acceptance-driven Chrome and Firefox extension development, repair-loop verification, and local packaging.

interface.shortDescription: Build browser extensions through proof-driven repair loops
interface.longDescription: Turns an explicit extension request into a confirmed acceptance contract and scoped Manifest V3 project for Chrome, Firefox, or both; repairs gaps until each criterion has current browser/package proof.

skillInstructions: Addonry is manual-only. Use its workflow and addonry-chrome-devtools MCP tools only after the user explicitly runs the provider's create-chrome-extension skill or command, or explicitly names Addonry for browser extension creation.

args: $roots = @($env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:KIMI_PLUGIN_ROOT, $env:PLUGIN_ROOT, (Get-Location).Path) | Where-Object { $_ }; $root = $roots | Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_ 'scripts/start-chrome-devtools-mcp.ps1') } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $root) { throw 'Addonry plugin root not found.' }; & (Join-Path $root 'scripts/start-chrome-devtools-mcp.ps1')
